headline: Safe to train: no leakage, no corrupt images, no bad boxes — only 3 orphan label files and 4 empty label files to clean up or confirm.
training_impact: Training runs fine as-is. The 3 orphan labels are never read (dead files). The 4 empty labels are treated as background images: if they are deliberate, zero impact; if they are lost annotations, you lose a few training boxes and one val image (val/000000045229) silently skews the validation number slightly.

decisions.rationale: 4 label files with zero boxes (3 train, 1 val). Empty labels are a legitimate background-image technique, but an unintended empty file is a silently dropped annotation. Spot-check the 4 images; the one in val (val/000000045229) is the only one that can touch your validation number — if it actually contains objects, your val metric is being quietly biased. Confirm deliberate, or re-annotate.
3 label files in train (639462453486, 915238652806, 920332787315) have no matching image. They are never read during training, so this is pure hygiene — delete them. No accuracy or stability impact.
